subject: Literature
title: Ragnarök and the End of the World
description: Learn Ragnarök and the End of the World in one minute.

hook.text: Norse mythology is unique because even the gods know they will die, and they fight on anyway.

buildup.text: Ragnarök prophesies a final battle where Odin, Thor, and Loki perish as the world burns and sinks into the sea.

discovery.text: After total destruction, the world is reborn fresh and green, and surviving gods rebuild civilization.

twist.text: Scholars debate whether the rebirth ending was always part of the myth or was added after Christian contact.

climax.text: Ragnarök shaped the fatalistic courage celebrated in Viking literature: fight bravely knowing defeat is certain.

punchline.text: The gods knew they would lose and fought anyway.

quiz.question: What is unique about the Norse gods' relationship to fate?
options: They are immortal and can never be harmed
They know they will die at Ragnarök but fight on regardless
They have the power to change their own destiny
